articleTitle: An Improved Support-Vector Network Model for Anti-Money Laundering
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The selection of parameters of SVM model will affect the identification effect of suspicious financial transactions, this paper proposes the cross validation method to find the optimal SVM classifier parameters to solve this problem. Cross validation method finds the optimal parameters based on the highest classification accuracy rate through grid search, it can effectively avoid the state of over-learning and less learning, and greatly improves the overall performance of the classifier.

articleTitle: Analysis of Bandwagon and Average Hybrid Attack Model against Trust-based Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Recommender systems have been accepted as a vital application on the web by offering product advice or information that users might be interested in. Despite its success, similarity-based collaborative filtering suffers from some significant limitations, such as scalability, sparsity and recommendation attack. Prior work has shown incorporating trust mechanism into traditional collaborative filtering recommender systems can improve these limitations. However, trust-based recommender systems are also known to be vulnerable to profile infection attacks. Malicious users can inject a large number of biased profiles into such a system in order to make recommendations that favor or disfavor given items. In this paper, we propose a bandwagon and average hybrid attack model and analysis the effectiveness of the attack model against topic-level trust-based recommender algorithm. The results of our experiments conducted on well-known dataset show that the hybrid attack model is more effective than other attack models.

articleTitle: Application of Ontology in E-Government
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Data sharing is the basis of E-Government's construction in E-Government work. In this paper, a new ontology-based system structure has been presented, in which a resource ontology expression layer has been inserted into the traditional E-government system structure, which enabled the isomerous data resource from different system sharing. We use document ontology as an example, introduced how to create a resource ontology on the aspect of entity, property and relationship. Finally, we use the OWL to describe the ontology we created. Elementary study shows that this kind of method has advantages over traditional structure of E-government, it could resolve the problem of isomerous data resource sharing in a certain extent.

articleTitle: The Application of Date Mining in Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Data mining is a step in the knowledge discovery process to extract implicit, unknown but potentially useful information from the incomplete, ambiguous and random data, it is the core of knowledge management. In this paper, we start from the basic relationship between data mining and knowledge management, and then focus on introducing the application of date mining in knowledge management.

articleTitle: Mining Investment Risk Analysis Based on Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: When investing mining projects, we often cannot make an accurate judgment of the investing project's risk degree because there are too many influential risk factors, with different kinds of uncertainties at the same time. To solve this problem, Monte Carlo simulation method is an effective way. It can be accomplished by computer software with enough times of sampling process. The analysis of the output can help judge the degree of risk. In this paper, the Monte Carlo simulation was performed in computer and applied to an iron ore mine investment. Base on the simulating results, this project's investing risk was analyzed. We illustrated the meanings of the simulation results and also provided suggestions to the investors.

articleTitle: The Protection Methods for Mobile Code Based on Homomorphic Encryption and Data Confusion
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The research for homomorphic encryption and calculation of the encryption function based on homomorphic encryption is still in its infancy, and encryption functions has been limited to the rational polynomial function in the existing program, with polynomial framework message of encrypted functions still being plaintext. This paper proposes a calculating method of homomorphic encryption function for the program logic of mobile code and critical data carried, by using the homomorphic encryption to coefficient and the power homomorphic encryption to index, and adding a function item with the coefficient key zero to hide the skeleton information of polynomial better. The encryption functions computation based on homomorphic encryption and hiding method for data proposed in the paper, have properly solved protection of the program logic of mobile code and carried data. Encryption functions based on homomorphic encryption and data hiding can directly operate cipher text operation, with operation results being automatically encrypted. A further analysis shows that using the proposed method can accomplish non-interactive encrypted computation of elementary functions and provide a new method for the protection of mobile code.

articleTitle: Research on the Efficient Path for Chinese Group-Purchase Website to Cope with Crisis of Confidence
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: After socialization group-purchase pattern, which Group on was a representive of, had get ahead in America, Chinese group-purchase websites expanded by leaps and bounds in 2010, because of low investment, low technology and simple mode. During the period, the problems of malicious fraud, quality of product and funds security ect. appeared in quantity, so the group-purchase websites were faced with crisis of confidence. This paper, which is mainly connection with commercial group-purchase pattern, analyses the main manifestation of crisis of confidence of Chinese group-purchase websites. In the end it studies the efficient path to cope with various crises.

articleTitle: Commercial Issues in Hybrid Cellular-ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Hybrid cellular-ad hoc network is the combination of cellular networks and ad hoc networks. Such a network is addressed to increase spatial reuse and save deployment cost. In the literature, most researchers paid attention to technical issues such as architecture and capacity of hybrid networks. In fact, before this kind of hybrid network becomes practical, some commercial issues should also be considered. In this paper, we discuss three of these issues: (1) the customer's will towards providing relay service, (2) routing metrics and routing protocol which consider customer's will, (3) charge modes for service providers and relay customers. Finally, we present some future work.

articleTitle: The Effects of Exchange Rate Volatility on Exports: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper empirically investigates the impact of the exchange rate volatility on the real export flows of China by using quarterly data from 1995Q1 to 2010Q1. Co-integration and error-correction models are employed to obtain the estimates of the long run equilibrium and the short-run dynamics, respectively. Our results concerning the effects of exchange rate volatility on real exports suggest that the long-run relationship between China's real exports and its bilateral real exchange rate volatility is negative and statistically significant, but the short-run impact of the exchange rate volatility is insignificantly positive.

articleTitle: Image Annotation Using the SimpleDecisionTree
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Automatic image annotation is an important but highly challenging problem in semantic-based image retrieval. In this paper, we formulate image annotation as a supervised learning image classification problem under region-based image annotation framework. In region-based image annotation, keywords are usually associated with individual regions in the training data set. This paper applys a novel simple decision tree (SDT) algorithm in our image annotation system, which can classify a large number of training data faster and more effectively. The proposed SDT algorithm is experimented on image annotation Corel data sets. Compared to classical algorithms, SDT accelerates the operation speed of the algorithm, and the classification accuracy remains robustness. It has a good application in automatic image annotation system.

articleTitle: The Impact of "Cloud Computing"-based Information Sharing on Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This research is intended to be an opening contribution to the analytical study of real time information sharing based on "Cloud Computing", then uses a simulation model to calculate the expected benefits of a "Cloud Computing"-based information sharing in a multi-echelon complex supply chain. The main objective of supply chain management is to optimize the entire system. The results of this study have the important implications for practitioners. Our results could also form the basis for empirical investigations into estimating the impact and value of information sharing in the supply chain.

articleTitle: Positive Analysis of Chinese Online Customer Behavior During the Transaction
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The paper advances the correlation between website quality and behavioral and attitudinal outcomes of transaction under the online context. Meanwhile, it also suggests the moderate effect of income and risk perception between website quality and outcome of transaction. Positive analysis is implemented by collecting data from Taobao.com, and the hypothesis are tested following the regression analysis by using SPSS. The author also gives managerial implication after the hypothesis are tested.

articleTitle: A RFID Mixed Coding Scheme Based on Huffman Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In RFID application systems with multiple packaging layers, labeling packaging relationship of objects in different packaging layers by encoding methods is a important technology field. Prefix-based labeling scheme is a method by which the packaging relationship of objects amounts to testing whether one object is an prefix of the other, whereas the region numbering scheme is a method by which an ancestor query amount to an interval containment test on the labels. This paper first presents a mixed-encoding scheme based on Huffman algorithm, then propose a variant of this encoding scheme in which new "virtual nodes" are involved in order to improve the stability of encoding. Our experiments prove that the mixed-based encoding scheme is effective due to the enhancement of update performance and query efficiency.

articleTitle: An Effective Approach for Generating 360-degree Panorama Views
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In creating a 360 degree panorama view, stitching together the front edge and the tail edge of a picture for a round view is usually difficult due to the differences and gaps accumulated in the process of stitching together pictures in the middle. In this work, we propose an effective approach based on texture matching and global coordinate constraints to solve this problem. Experiments proved the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Evolution in RFID Credit Card Security by Using Wireless Sensing Network
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

"Evolution in RFID Credit Card Security by using Wireless Sensing Network"
by Rohit Sharma, Prakaj Singh and Ravikant Saini in the Proceedings of the 2011 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government, November 2011

This paper contains duplicate text from the papers cited below. The original text was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper titles) and without permission.

in Information Security Practice and Experience, April 2009

"Vulnerabilities in First-Generation RFID-enabled Credit Cards"

by Thomas S. Heydt-Benjamin, Daniel V. Bailey, Kevin Fu, Ari Juels and Tom O'Hare
in The New York Times, 2007


The main idea of this paper is to integrate RFID technology and WSN to build an intelligent & secured RFID credit card system. Two scenarios of integration have been implemented. In the first one, we not extended the read range of the RFID system by adding wireless facility to RFID readers. Each RFID reader is equipped with a wireless module which can transmit data to and from the reader. RFID reader acts as sensor node: it reads the identification of an object and sends it to the host application via an ad-hoc network. The second scenario of integration provides RFID readers with sensing ability. Several motion sensors are installed near each reader to detect the presence of a tagged object and to command the reader activity.

articleTitle: Lagrangian Relaxation for Parallel Machine Batch Scheduling with Deteriorating Jobs
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: We investigate the problem of scheduling jobs with batch production on the identical parallel machines with respect to time-deteriorating processing time in which the processing time of a job is a piecewise linear deterioration function of its starting time. The objective is to find a feasible schedule that minimizes the total completion times of jobs. This paper proposes a batch decoupling based Lagrangian relaxation algorithm for this problem. In this algorithm, after capacity constraints are relaxed by Lagrangian multipliers, the relaxed problem can be decomposed into batch-level subproblems. The extensive computational experiments are carried out and the results show that the proposed algorithm can solve the problem effectively in a reasonable amount of the computation time.

articleTitle: The Research of Collaborative PDM Based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: For the quickly growing requirements of information sharing and business integration in enterprise, it tends to design a collaborative Product Data Management(PDM) to integrate the product data in enterprise internal and external environment. In this paper, the author has designed one kind of the collaborative design for PDM based on SOA. So in enterprise PDM can communicate and integrate with ERP, CAD, CAM and so on. On the other hand, it also can realize the communication and integration of different PDMs during different companies through use the technology of SOA-oriented Enterprise Service Bus(s-ESB). As a result, the company would be able to fulfill our aims of information sharing and business integration.

articleTitle: Pricing and Ordering Policies in a Supply Chain with Risk-Averse Retailer and Asymmetric Information
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper studies the pricing and ordering policy of a two-echelon supply chain with a risk-neutral supplier and a risk-averse retailer, the risk aversion of the retailer is measured by CVaR. The retailer has accurate demand information while the supplier does not. The research shows that the uncertainty of the supplier on the demand will lead to a reduction of the supplier's expected profit, which also shows the value of information. Moreover, the uncertainty on the demand will lead to a biased forecast of the expected profit for the supplier.

articleTitle: Immune-based Distributed Forensics System for e-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The information security is very important to the development of electronic commerce. Inspired by the immune principle, the paper designs an Immune-based Distributed Forensics System for e-Commerce (IDFSEC). The system consists of distributed and independent nodes which monitor hierarchical objects from network to service in the e-Commerce site. The paper presents the forensics mechanism of node and the building mechanism of an evidence link. Lastly, experiment is performed to validate the effectivity of IDFSEC.

articleTitle: Exploring the Factors Influencing Users' Acceptance of Sponsored Search
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: For the foreseeable future, sponsored search appears to be the principal revenue source for web search engines. However, user acceptance of the sponsored link is not high. Based on the technology acceptance model (TAM), this paper designs the acceptance model of sponsored link to explore factors influencing user acceptance of the sponsored link. Surveys with college students and white collar (n=162) were conducted. Based on the results of the data analysis, several key factors are found. At last, some suggestions are made for the web search engines and the advertisers.

articleTitle: China's Financial Industry Software Application Analysis and Development Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the development of global information process, tremendous improvement has been seen in China's financial informationization, the software in the financial industry has been made significant applications. The development of software applications on the financial sector has significant impacts, both the positive sides, as well as the negative sides. Therefore, it is essential to make appropriate financial software applications development strategy. This essay addresses the detailed implement of China's financial industry software applications by the introduction of the overall strategic objectives in financial software applications development.

articleTitle: The Development Strategy of Native Clothing Brand in B2C E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper based on the development situation of several native clothing brands in B2C marketing, analysis and discussion the question of development. The result found that the disadvantage of B2C sales platform, industry chain logistics links not perfect, ignore to promote the value, face double challenge are the main limiting factors. And this paper put forward the following strategies to promote the developing of native clothing brand in the B2C marketing: establish clear developing plan, promote the internal conditions, explore own advantages.

articleTitle: An Evaluation System on Commercial Bank's Capital Quality Based on AHP and Rough Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of finance market, the financial organizations meet the heavier risk than ever. We set up a model to assess the commercial bank's capital quality and risk with AHP method and rough set theory. In this paper, we firstly analyze the factors related to the quality of capital and use AHP method to gain the weigh of each factor. Secondly, we establish a mark system. The standard for evaluation is based on the national standard or the advice from experts. Through the system, we have an overall evaluation on each bank's capital quality risk. Thirdly, we discretize the value of each sample and calculate the relativity of each factor to the evaluation by rough set theory. And finally we revise the weigh of each factor and get the final evaluation. In this way, we integrate the subjective and objective opinions to gain a more accurate evaluation on the capital quality of commercial bank.

articleTitle: Research on the Design-centered E-Commerce Platform
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the design becoming more and more critical in the process of production, the consumption of product can be described as the consumption of design to some extent. In order to provide better design services for the customers, the design-centered e-commerce platform is researched in this paper. The operation of the platform is based on the integrative database and the platform has two functions which are assistance and management.

articleTitle: The Design and Realization of Online Employment System
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The design and layer-based structure of the MVC (Model-View-Controller) is becoming more and more popular. The layer-based structure can efficiently decrease the dependence of each layer and greatly increase the extendibility and maintenance of the MVC. The Paper introduces the MVC design and application for online employment.

articleTitle: Threshold Selection Using Maximum Autocorrelation Principle
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The threshold selection method for image segmentation presented here is based on maximum autocorrelation principle. The optimal threshold value is determined by maximizing the autocorrelation measure. The predominance of our method is using both gray similarity and spatial continuity in object and background region of the image. The effectiveness of the thresholding results are demonstrated by its performance on some categories images.

articleTitle: Research of E-government Auto Answer Consulting System Architechture
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: E-government is a virtualized platform which is used by the government to do the administration online. According to the observation from a growing perspective, the e-government platform should be an intelligent information management bases. In an information based e-government platform, consulting subsystem plays an important roll. Here comes up with an auto-answer counseling subsystem as an attempt. There are two key technologies with this system, a classical auto-response subsystem which supported by a database, and an AI auto-response system which can understand our nature language.

articleTitle: Petri-net-based Modeling of Online Shopping Workflow
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Due to the complexity of modern e-Business systems is steadily increasing, the analysis and design of e-Business systems using workflow is of great interest. A model design with workflow allows optimization and flexibility of the implementation of the e-Business systems. This paper describes the ongoing development of a Petri-Net-based workflow online shopping system. The described system presents a typical process of online ordering and shipping management system that provides better scalability of system analysis and design.

articleTitle: The Influencing Factors of R&D Input and the Application of Knowledge Production Function-Based on the Panel Data of China
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Choosing China's eastern, central and western panel data between 2000-2005, by applying panel data model, from the supply and demand aspects which influence R&D, this paper analyzes the decisive influence of supply and demand factors of R&D input in the form of knowledge production function. Besides this paper also analyzes the economies of scale of knowledge production function. The result shows that there exists difference of R&D input and output among different regions which shows economic development level has significant effect on innovation capability. Besides, this paper finds that industrial structure has important decisive influence on independent innovation.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of New Loan Patterns Based on E-Finance for Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: As a new channel of loan, network loan is more suitable than traditional bank loan for small and medium-sized enterprises. Various network loan services are provided by commercial banks and e-commerce platforms. This paper deals with the relative advantages and applications of some kinds of network loan for small and medium-sized enterprises, by the comparative analysis of several typical ways of network loan, such as network joint guarantee loan, e-commerce platform loan, revolving loan of e-bank, etc. And the conclusion is that these kinds of network loan have their respective advantages and limits. So the requirements and business characteristic should be clear and considered when the enterprises carry on network loan, instead of blindly choice.

articleTitle: Method of Association Rule Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm and Application of Network Consuming for the Contemporary Youth
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Genetic Algorithm and Association Rules both are commonly used methods in data mining. In this paper, a brief overview of Genetic Algorithm and Association Rules has been given, and this paper has presented an improved extract method of association rules of genetic algorithm based on their respective advantages and disadvantages. It also did some research on designing encoding methods, structuring and choosing fitness functions, and improving crossover operators and mutation operators. In the end, the analysis of contemporary youth consumption condition has been shown as a specific example to illustrate the process of mining association rules of contemporary youth's consumption behavior.

articleTitle: The Research for the Performance Evaluation Index System of Supply Chain Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Today, internet of things is on the rapid development stage. Scientific measures for supply chain performance which based on internet of things is an important content of the supply chain management. This article establishes the performance evaluation index system which based on internet of things from five aspects. They are financial, customer, business process, node coordination and information transmission, then using the AHP method and the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to evaluate.

articleTitle: Dynamic Load-Balancing in iSCSI Systems Based on a Feedback Control Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Multiple network cards and multiple connections in iSCSI are important ways to improve iSCSI systems performance, fault tolerance and scalability. But multiple connections technology cannot assign every task appropriately, so it cannot produce the excellent performance. This paper proposes a dynamic load balancing algorithm using a feedback control mechanism to improve the overall performance in iSCSI systems. In order to adjust the load state dynamically, this algorithm adopts a feedback mechanism to calculate multiple resources states that have been collected in this system, and then combines the results and the previous feedback. The test results indicate that with the help of this algorithm the performance of iSCSI system has been improved.

articleTitle: The Hybrid MCDM Model for Performance Assessment in Mobile Commerce Development
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This study applies a hybrid MCDM model for risk evaluation in Mobile Commerce development. First, the risk in MC development is formulated by the combined use of the MCDM (multi-criteria decision making) approach and a proposed five-step hybrid process, which incorporates the technique of ANP (analytic network process) and TOPSIS (technique for order performance by similarity to idea solution). The newly developed ANP will eventually yield the relative weights of the multiple evaluation criteria. Then the TOPSIS is adopted to rank the risk in terms of their overall performances. At last, an example is solved to illustrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the suggested model. The empirical study has demonstrated how the approach can be used for the risk evaluation in MC development.

articleTitle: Design of Enterprise Competitor Information Search Engine Based on Web Service
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Basing on web service technology, the enterprise competitor information search engine comes true. This engine can intelligently search out target HTML pages from many enterprises' portals website and has good expansibility, security and validity.

articleTitle: Study of the Relationship between the Emotional Tendencies of Web Financial Information and the Financial Crisis of Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: As the rapid development of Internet technology, the influence to the financial fields of the financial information on the Web has become increasingly can not be ignored. Facing mass unstructured Web text about financial information, the paper present a method to calculate the tendency of text, and analysis the relationship between the emotional tendencies of Web financial information and the financial crisis of listed companies qualitatively. Via empirical analysis, Financial Warning for listed companies by using of Web financial information is not only feasible, but also ahead of financial indicators more than 3-4 quarter.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction in Abnormal Pattern Recognition of Financial Transaction
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Feature extractors are used to get mathematical features that can be machine readable. In this paper we proposed a novel feature extraction and similarity measurement method based on RBF neural network one-step deviation prediction, which is different from traditional time series researches. The method converts time series similarity to feature vectors similarity comparison, while feature vectors are associated with physical information. Experiments show that this method has obvious advantages compared to traditional time series researches. It can detect abnormal patterns of financial transactions effectively.

articleTitle: A Query-Oriented Summarization System for XML Elements
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In document-center XML dataset, an element may contain so many text that users have to spend enough time to judge the elements returned by XML search engine are valuable or not. Query-orient XML summarization system aim to provide users a brief and readable substitution of the original retrieved elements according to the user's query, which can relieve user's reading burden effectively. In this work, we extract sentences from the results of XML search engine, and combine them as a summary. Experiments on the IEEE-CS datasets used in INEX show that, the query-oriented XML summary generated by our method is reasonable.

articleTitle: Study on Double-Layers Trust System and Model of Trust in P2PEB Mode
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The development trend of E-Business is the P2PEB. In this mode, trust is the base to guarantee the normal conduction of the business activity. According to the features of trust between Enterprises, we propose a double layers trust system in P2PEB mode named as DL-Trust System. After explaining the different mechanisms of the direct trust and indirect trust and discussing the interaction of the double trust, we build a corresponding trust model based on which a trustable trade partner can be selected.

articleTitle: A Test Case Design Algorithm Based on Priority Techniques
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Testing is an important step of building e-commerce system. In regression testing, it is the key issue that how to reuse the test suite efficiently. This paper presents a dynamic adjustment prioritization based on the design information of test suite which is a new exploration of regression test prioritization. It improves the shortcoming of the existing technologies which failed to use the design information of test cases effectively. It adjusts the priority of test case by collecting running information, gradually optimizes the test suite and makes the test suite adapted to the current test environment to obtain a better error detection results. Experiments show the error-detected efficiency of it has certain advantages than the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Cryptanalysis of the certificateless encryption schemes strongly secure in the standard model
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Certificateless cryptography solves the key escrow problem that is inherent in the ID-based in the identity-based cryptography. In PKC 2008, Dent et al. proposed a certificateless encryption schemes strongly secure in the standard model. They claimed that their CLE encryption scheme is provably strongly secure against a strong type I adversary and type II adversary. In this paper, we show that their certificateless encryption scheme is completely insecure and the claim of provable security is seriously incorrect by a type I adversary who can replace users' public keys and access to the encrypting oracle under the replaced public keys.

articleTitle: A Copula Model Applied to the Correlation among A-share, H-share and N-share
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper uses bivariate copula model to analyze Dependence relationship between A-share, H-share and N-share Markets from June 1, 2005 to August 31, 2009. First, the parameters of marginal distribution model for yield of A, H and N stock index are estimated by maximum likelihood method. After the most appropriate marginal distribution model selected, the parameters of the Candidate copulas are calculated by maximum likelihood method. Then, using Chi-square test, we can chose a the most appropriate copula model. The Kendall's rank correlation and the tail related coefficient can be acquired with parameter of the most appropriate copula. According to empirical analysis, we find several important characters of these stock markets.

articleTitle: On Resource Allocation and Consumption Trend of Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the construction and perfection of China's market economy, higher education in China has developed fast and correspondingly resource distributing of higher education has changed a lot. China has transferred its economic mechanism from plan system to market economy, in which market has been a main resource distribution method. Market is the most effective way and has its advantage in distributing educational resource, however market also has its inherent flaws to which should be paid attention in resource distribution. With the changes in distributing educational resource, China's consumption tendency of higher education will show some new characteristics. This paper firstly gives the introduction to the concepts of scarcity and distribution methods of higher education, and then analyzes the current condition of China's resource distribution of higher education. On the base of putting forward some countermeasures, the paper lastly points out the consumption tendency of higher education in China.

articleTitle: Improved Authentication Tests Theory and its Application in E-commerce Protocols
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Authentication Test theory, based on Strand Space model, is a novel method to verify security features of E-commerce protocols. The goal of the paper is to improve original Authentication Tests Theory, so that we can avoid sort of replay attacks in E-commerce protocols. The paper present a improved version of Authentication Tests Theory, and then apply it to the analysis of Improved Wide-Mouth Frog Protocol. The result confirms that Improved Wide-Mouth Frog Protocol succeed in protecting session key and authenticating identities of both participants.

articleTitle: Selection of Multimedia Data Source Based on User Feedback
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: There are hundreds or thousands of web data sources providing data of relevance to a particular domain on the Web, so how to find a suitable set of sources quickly to integrate from a number of sources is becoming more and more important. Traditional data sources selection methods that are based on data quality do not consider quality characteristics of data sources under the different domains, but select the same quality dimensions for quality evaluation models. As a result, accuracies of a traditional method under different domains are quite different. In light of this, we propose a Web multimedia source selection method based on user feedback. We gain accurate core quality dimensions of data sources under the multimedia domain based on user feedback, and then achieve a quality estimation model of the multimedia data sources. The experiments on hundreds of real-world multimedia data sources have proved that our approach is efficient and accurate.

articleTitle: Lifting Wavelet Based Volatility Spillover Effect Analysis of Stock Markets in the Greater China Region
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The volatility of a stock market is affected by both their own former fluctuations and other market fluctuations in the past, but how this effect come into being is rarely mentioned before. Through volatility spillover research of three markets in the Greater China Region, this paper aims at identifying whether the market's volatility spillover effect is due to special events, or because of the existence of such interdependence among markets. First, the paper makes an analysis of GARCH residuals spillover among three markets in China over two periods. Then, using lifting wavelet method to extract the GARCH residuals data and remove outliers, the paper finally analyzes the causes of spillover effects among the three markets and the link between the three markets.

articleTitle: The Structure of the Electronic Government System Based on CATV
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The E-Government is the most comprehensive application on the Internet, using the Interactive technologies outside to build a one-stop E-Government in the CATV network is the best choice of taking advantage of the existing CATV network resources, the most essential thing about building the E-Government in CATV network is to establish a secure Information Channel, the establishment of the secure information channel have to draw support from the PKI technology.

Author Keywords: The diplomatic type network each other

articleTitle: Time Identification of Electronic Documents
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: How to identify documents and files' real formation time (documents writing time) and revision etc. is an important work to maintain the original history appearance and play its proof role in judicial practice, history study, literature study, files managements, e-commerce and e-government affairs development, which is very important. By studying the domestic and foreign literature, from the current research situation that only solved the problems of creation time, latest modification time and latest access time. For the problems of how to make sure the files time when its had been changed, copied, deleted, recovered for many times, how to make sure it's creation time and upload time on the web front platform before entering the server, how to make sure the files creation time when the system time is not right as well as how to set and implement the time sign management standards during the files creation process etc., which need further research. Many technical methods of electronic document's time identification is given in the paper.

articleTitle: A Three-Dimensional Model for E-Government Development with Cases in China's Regional E-Government Practice and Experience
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: E-government is promising in terms of better service delivery and more efficient administration management. Many models for e-government development have been developed for the understanding and improvement of e-government in the past decade. Recent empirical studies have shown, however, inconsistencies between the models and the e-government evolution around the world. We propose a three-dimensional model for e-government development in this paper, based on existing theoretical and empirical studies, as well as our practice and experience in China's regional e-government development. A novel feature of our model is that it connects the three major influencing aspects: the stage of e-governance, the functionality of e-government, and the effectiveness of e-government. This feature makes it possible to improve our understanding and further enhance the development of e-government.

articleTitle: How Does Social Capital Influence Online P2P Lending? A Cross-Country Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Online People-to-People (P2P) lending marketplace allows individuals to lend and borrow directly among each other without the mediation of a creditor bank institution. Prior literature has examined how social capital influences P2P loan performance, but has largely been limited to the Western context. This paper thus explores how social capital influences P2P lending in the U.S. and China. Based on the archival data of Prosper and PPDai, we compare the influence of social capital in different communities and different cultures. The empirical results show that social capital is not equally important in different cultures. Social capital seems to be more influential for likelihood of getting funded in China than in the U.S. In contrast, social capital has influence on interest rate in the U.S. only. Our study thus extends current understanding about how social capital influences online communities in a global perspective.

articleTitle: Building a Change Management Model for E-Government Services Evolution
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: E-government systems are subject to continual changed regulations and laws. In this paper, we show how the usage of semantic web technologies for describing e-government services and its regulations and laws can improve the services evolution. We build a change management model for automatically checking the compliance of e-government services with regulations and laws. We combine semantically described e-government services/processes with an extension of OWL-S and SWRL rules by a set of ontologies, capturing knowledge about the government domain. These formal specifications enable us to automatically check if a process description satisfies the consistency constraints defined by formal rules and ensure the e-government services evolution.

articleTitle: Two-Phase Clustering-based Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Internet and E-Commerce are becoming an integral part of everyday life as we accumulate more and more knowledge that demands for some personalized recommendation technology. Collaborative filtering recommendation is the most successful personalized recommendation algorithm among current technologies. The paper suggests the two-phase clustering-based collaborative filtering algorithm. which not only reduces the sparsity of data and improves the accuracy of the nearest neighbor, but also improves the recommendation accuracy and reduces the time complexity compared with the traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Web Marketing Applicability of Commodities
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Based on the transaction process, we build an analytical model about web marking applicability of commodities in this paper, and use it in the analysis, then we conclude that three index (abundance of commodities, concern degree and conversion rate of transaction) can be used to describe web marketing applicability of goods. Following this, we apply the data of three typical products (search, experience and trust categories) from Taobao and eBay for verification.

articleTitle: A Benchmark-Based Approach for Evaluating Capability of Enterprise Web Portals
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Business of all kinds is increasingly being conducted on-line, potentially dissolving the boundaries between local, national and global entities. No matter how sophisticated a company's traditional business model is, its e-business capability is only as effective as its enterprise web portal. It is therefore important for a company to evaluate its web portal's e-business capability against those in similar businesses, in order to improve the company's competitiveness on the internet. This paper describes a benchmark-based evaluation approach for the purpose. By choosing a set of enterprise web portals leading the best practices of e-business in a specific business sector, a benchmark of e-business capability and criteria can be established. The benchmark can then be used to evaluate the e-business capability of a specific enterprise web portal, resulting indications where the evaluated web portal can be improved. The novelty of the approach is that the capability evaluation based on the approach gives specific indications of possible improvement for the evaluated portal. The limitation of the approach is that it requires a rather deeper understanding of the business sector in order to establish the benchmark. The paper also describes a case study on using the approach for Mainland Chinese IT sector.

articleTitle: Mining 3D Visualization Simulation and Safety Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: There are many unsafe factors with residual ore bodies in complex environments, since mining industry simply be an industry with frequent accidents. Because it is able to make the analyzing more clear to the affect factors by 3D visualization simulation, a method for mining visualization simulation and safety assessment is introduced based on reviewing the visualization theories and research results at home and abroad in the paper. After that a visualization model is established by DIMINE mine visualization software with the mining and geological condition of JSD mine 312 ore block for illustration. This model can clearly show the shape and spatial distribution and the unsafe state of the mined-out areas and caving area and subsided area around the block in any angle. Based on the results, the LEC approach is applied to scientifically determine the major hazards of the block, which may make the block mining design more reasonable and safety.

articleTitle: The Construction of the Government's Core Competitiveness under the Network Environment - A Case Study of Fujian Provincial Government
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In the modern era of increasingly fierce social competition, the competition among the governments is also becoming increasingly fierce. Under the influence of the network environment, the governments are badly in need of building their own core competitiveness to preferably gain legitimacy and credibility. On the basis of expounding the connotation of the government's core competitiveness as well as the impact and influence on the government's core competitiveness from the Internet, this paper analyzes the competition environment and the competitive problems of Fujian Provincial Government, and points out that under the network environment, the core competitiveness of Fujian Provincial Government means government's information ability, government's decision-making ability, government's executive ability and government's regulation ability. Meanwhile, this article proposes some countermeasures for the construction of Fujian Provincial Government's core competitiveness.

articleTitle: Clustering XML Search Results Based on Content and Structure Similarity
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Clustering XML search results is an effective way to improve performance. However, the key problem is how to measure similarity between XML documents. In this paper, we propose a semantic similarity measure method combining content with structure, in which a variety of XML document features, including term element frequency, term inverse element frequency, semantic weight of tag label and level information of the term, are analyzed and applied for computing the similarity between XML documents. In addition, two new performance evaluation methodology, namely ClusterRatio_Relevant and DocuRatio_Relevant, for clustering quality are introduced motivated by the observations of relevant documents distribution and the fact that collection has no classification information. Experiment results show that proposed similarity method(CAS measure)outperforms traditional document clustering(CO measure) in ClusterRatio_Relevant and DocuRatio_Relevant and produces better clustering quality.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Mechanism of Environment Improvement Policy Promoting Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: According to the endogenous economic growth theory, environment improvement policy is the means to promote economic growth. The paper sets the Hamiltonian optimization model with emission tax policy and emission abatement investment policy being endogenous. By mathematical analysis, we find that environment policy can stimulate human capital and technological advances accumulating much faster so as to offset the negative effect of the decreasing growth rate of pollution natural resources on economic growth along BGP, acquiring "double-win" performance of environment and economy under low carbon economy. By numerical simulation, we find 2 Balanced Growth Paths (BGPs) with 40-50% reduction in pollution emission, which lives up to the low-carbon promise of Copenhagen Climate Conference.

articleTitle: Genetic Interpretation of American Financial Bailout: Gene Recombination Model and its Application
publicationTitle: 2011 Fifth International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This author proposes a Gene Recombination Model, encompassing the six sub-models, homologous recombination, site-specific recombination, double strand break recombination, chromosome rearrangement, template-selective recombination and transposition recombination. His model application has noticed that, the American financial innovation changed the fundamental structure of the original American financial system. The entire financial genome structure mutated, causing the American financial crisis. The "traditional" financial system has a strong existing capability and a reasonable gene structure, and these are the product of a natural and history-long choice. Financial bailout is an artificial financial gene recombination operation, and it should restructure an ailing financial system back to a "traditional" gene structure. The fact that the American banking business has already run out of the crisis shadow indicates that, returning to the "traditional" structure is a right choice.
